mechanism: Amoxicillin (beta-lactam) may enhance nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity of amikacin (aminoglycoside), and aminoglycosides can reduce beta-lactam efficacy by inhibiting bacterial cell wall penetration during static phase.
action: Monitor renal function, serum creatinine, and audiometry closely; ensure adequate hydration; use only when clinically justified for synergistic coverage of resistant gram-negative infections; consider therapeutic drug monitoring of amikacin.
